name: friend-feud
description: Friend Feud local-network game development workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace @friend-feud/api" "npm run dev --workspace @friend-feud/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @friend-feud/api && npm run build --workspace @friend-feud/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @friend-feud/api && npm run lint --workspace @friend-feud/web
